sentences.text: Researchers examined the relationship between cognitive test scores and white matter health in 22 people with early-stage Huntington's disease and 20 healthy controls using Diffusion Tensor Imaging, a brain scan technique that measures white matter properties.
A statistical method was applied to compare the two groups and link the brain scan measurements to the patients' performance on different parts of the cognitive test.
Among the cognitive areas tested, only visuospatial ability was linked to the condition of white matter in three specific brain regions.
The authors suggest that combining brain scans with a short cognitive screening tool can help identify specific brain areas related to certain cognitive skills in early-stage patients.
